data.name: Ninja Dodgeball
data.detailed_description:
Ninja Dodgeball

Step into the arena where reflexes, timing, and precision decide everything. In Ninja Dodgeball, players battle in fast-paced matches where a single ball becomes the ultimate weapon. Master its physics, deflect it with perfect timing, and send it flying back at your opponents at impossible speeds.

Inspired by classic dodgeball modes like Genji Dodgeball and TF2 Dodgeball, Ninja Dodgeball brings the concept into its own unique, skill-based arena experience.

Created by a solo-indie developer who does some basic grunt healthcare stuff as my job :D

Master the Ball

The ball isn’t just thrown — it’s controlled through skillful deflection and movement. Build momentum as players volley it back and forth until it becomes a lightning-fast projectile capable of taking down anyone in its path.

Ninja Movement

Stay alive with fast, responsive ninja abilities:

  • Reflect incoming balls back at enemies

  • Dash to evade impossible shots

  • Attack to redirect and control the ball’s trajectory

Precision and timing are everything. One mistake and you're out.

Fast Competitive Matches

Jump into intense arena matches where every round becomes a high-speed duel of reaction time and strategy. The longer a rally lasts, the faster and more dangerous the ball becomes.

Key Features

  • Fast-paced multiplayer dodgeball combat

  • Skill-based ball physics that reward precision

  • Reflect, dash, and attack mechanics for advanced play

  • Increasing ball speed that escalates every rally

  • Competitive arena gameplay focused on reflex and mind games

Only the fastest ninjas survive.

Can you deflect the impossible?
